claims.claim_text: Executive technology leader who connects IBM-AWS alliance co-sell leadership with platform productization and disciplined modernization delivery.
The operating model aligns partner strategy, joint solution development, and governed AI platform direction around executive decisions and repeatable customer value.
From that alliance foundation, cloud-vendor joint go-to-market execution and co-selling produced 20% joint revenue growth.
Against that commercial rhythm, release automation and security scanning were embedded in regulated modernization delivery paths, strengthening delivery resilience.
In parallel, platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue while supporting margin expansion and team scale.
The combined model enables future partner-led AI solutions to integrate alliance execution, secure release paths, and platform IP growth.
